description: Discover accessible Meta Business assets read-only: businesses, pages, Instagram accounts, pixels, and datasets when permissions allow.

adAccountId.description: Optional ad account ID to discover its owner Business and assigned pixels; datasets are read from that Business when permitted.

businessId.description: Business Manager ID. With adAccountId, discover only its owning Business; otherwise list /me/businesses when this is omitted.

cursor.description: Legacy cursor for /me/businesses only. Use cursors for asset edges.

cursors.description: Per-edge cursors from paging/nextActions. Never reuse a cursor for another edge.

limit.description: Maximum number of returned items or rows. The declared bounds and default apply; use pagination for additional results.

maxPages.description: Maximum pages per edge; remaining pages are reported explicitly.

name: meta_get_business_assets

result.description: Original tool result: parsed JSON when the text is JSON, otherwise the text or multiple MCP content blocks. Provider fields depend on the selected query.
